1.2.2 (the six step-7 primitives exported file-level, `PI` from siting), 1.2.3 / 1.2.4 (`sides.ts` untouched; `SEEDS`
shared where equal), §2 (the exported primitives' headers), the frozen API (J263 Q1) and NO-SHIFT (J260 (3), J264 (5)).

targeted (plus one strengthened variant), 41 red against NEAR, among them every killed mutant the plan's oracle names
that this seat re-applied (m46, m37, m43, c01, c02, c04 – c10) and 22 of round 1's killed promises; the 3 survivors are
judged below (two equivalent, one a pre-existing test gap, note N12). Refusals over the item's registered families are
the same before and after (0 at attempt 0; 21 = 21 at ladder attempts 1 – 2), so the count did not rise. No new finding
is a blocker; notes N12 – N14 are appended to `checks/M0-b-02-notes.md`.

### Line 3 — §2: the exported primitives' headers; no other comment change — **FIXED**, CONFIRMED

Each rewritten header read against its body and its call sites:

| name | header says | code |
|---|---|---|
| `M_TO_CM` | centimetres per metre; the cut table's metre cells read in cm; infill's one definition | `100`; `cutCells` multiplies `tangentWindowM`, `flattenM`, `portalGapMinM`, `laneM` by it — true (it also scales the context's `depthRangeM`, `minFrontageM`: a tightening, note N13) |
| `RAD_PER_CDEG` | π ÷ 18 000 on siting's π, the double `PI / 18000`; never swapped for growth's literal, one ulp above | `PI / 18000` with `PI` imported from `siting/geom.js`; 1 ulp checked above |
| `TOUCH_CM` | half a lattice unit, a touch at a segment's end and a hit too near its origin; `enceinte/plane.ts`'s `TOUCH_CM` is the insertion's attraction, another quantity | `0.5` = `LATTICE.unitCm / 2`; used as `rayHit`'s `minT`, `segmentClear`'s tolerance, the foot's end margin; `plane.ts:14` is `LATTICE.attractCm`, its own doc says "the insertion's attraction distance" |
| `cornerScale` | the face's widest spine half-width; sideRuns' `arcMaxCm` when the context gives none (C-0222 (3)) | max of `spines[].halfWidthCm`, 0 without spines; `planCut` passes `ctx.cornerScaleCm ?? cornerScale(face)` to `faceSides`, whose third argument is `sideRuns`' `arcMaxCm` |
| `arrivalDot2` | squared-cosine bound of the arrival band (§4.6 step 7, C-0222 (9)): an arrival within [lo, hi] cdeg has dot² at most this | `max(cos²(lo·RAD_PER_CDEG), cos²(hi·RAD_PER_CDEG))` over `portalArrivalCdeg` |
| `arrivesSquare` | the leg's unit direction's dot² with the spine direction at most `bound`; false for a leg too short to have a direction | `unit(sub(at, from))`, `null → false`, `d * d <= bound`; `unit` is null below 2⁻²⁰ cm or non-finite |

No other comment changed (the diff above); no message text changed; the removed `PI` doc line went with the literal.
None of the new headers narrates a round.
